question: What act of instruction is being performed here with respect to the practice of the soul for the addressed one?
premises: This practice of the soul is stated.
It has been told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: The practice of the soul has now been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of that practice is not repeated in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
